item.title: Gold prices dip slightly after record highs in India; Check rates here
item.description: Gold prices in India saw a slight decline after hitting record highs in 2025. According to IBJA, 24-carat gold fell from ₹1,42,300 to ₹1,41,800 per 10 grams. Silver also softened, with Delhi prices dropping to ₹2,35,440 per kg. The fall is attributed to a 1.54% drop in international gold rates, currently trading at $4,462 per ounce.

item.title: Mahayuti finalises seat-sharing for BMC polls; BJP gets 137, Shiv Sena 90
item.description: With the seat distribution now settled, candidates from both the BJP and the Shiv Sena are set to file their nomination papers tomorrow, marking the formal start of the alliance’s electoral campaign for the country’s richest civic body.

item.title: US President Donald Trump to receive Israel Peace Prize; Netanyahu to breaks old tradition
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump will be awarded Israel’s highest civilian honor, the Israel Peace Prize, marking the first time in 80 years it has been given to a non-Israeli. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu announced the decision after meeting Trump in Florida, highlighting his contributions to Israeli and Jewish communities and support in the fight against terrorism.

item.title: Stock Market: Nifty slumps below 25,900; Eternal shares down over 1.5%
item.description: Eternal Ltd shares fell over 1.5%, extending their decline from recent highs, as profit-taking and broader market weakness weighed on the stock, despite analysts maintaining a positive outlook on the company’s market position.

item.title: Priyanka Gandhi’s son Raihan Vadra gets engaged to long-time girlfriend Aviva Baig: Sources
item.description: Rahul Gandhi’s sister Priyanka Gandhi and businessman Robert Vadra’s son Raihan Vadra is going to engaged to his long-time girlfriend Aviva Beg. The couple, together for seven years, recently got their family approval.

item.title: From Homemaker to Power Centre: The journey of Bangladesh’s 1st woman Prime Minister
item.description: Khaleda Zia was suffering from kidney and heart disease, as well as pneumonia. For several years, she had been battling various complications, including liver cirrhosis, arthritis, diabetes, kidney, lung, and eye problems.

item.title: Unnao Case: 10 arguments Sengar daughter Aishwarya and Ishita fight to defend father
item.description: Supreme Court stays Delhi High Court’s order granting relief to former BJP MLA Kuldeep Singh Sengar in the Unnao rape case. Following the ruling, his daughters, Aishwarya and Ishita Sengar, have actively defended him, presenting arguments on social media and public platforms claiming his innocence.

item.title: Uttarakhand: Bus plunges into gorge in Almora; 7 Dead, several injured
item.description: The bus belonging to Kumaon Mandal Vikas Nigam (KMVN), was on its way to Ramnagar when it lost control near Bhikiyasen.

item.title: Vijay Deverakonda, Rashmika Mandanna set to tie knot in 2026; Royal wedding details revealed
item.description: South cinema’s popular stars, Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Mandanna, are set to tie the knot in 2026. The couple, long rumored to be dating, will have a royal wedding at a heritage palace in Udaipur on February 26.

item.title: Year Ender 2025: Top OTT releases everyone was talking about; How many have you watched?
item.description: 2025 was a landmark year for OTT platforms, with global audiences glued to streaming content. From the emotional finale of Stranger Things 5 to the remastered Baahubali: The Epic, binge-worthy thrillers like Black Warrant, gripping dramas like The Royals, and docu-series such as The Roshans, OTT captured diverse tastes.
